route_title: SiO2/Al2O3 multi-cavity stack for sharp bandpass edges
compilation_rationale: Corrected layer count to exactly 25 finite coating layers as explicitly declared. Replaced the over-expanded sequence with a compact alternating SIO2/Al2O3 stack. Uniform quarter-wave initial guess (~45 nm) and broad bounds around the UV center wavelength preserve optimization freedom. Objectives preserve all three transmittance bands.
